signal: Placer.ai surpassed $100M ARR and 4,300-plus customers and launched a collaboration bringing location analytics to commercial mortgage-backed securities

email.body1:
Aislinn, saw Placer.ai past $100M ARR and 4,300 customers, now pushing location analytics into commercial mortgage-backed securities.

Growth like that buries SDRs in more accounts and inbound than they can follow up on, which drags ramp and response speed. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your team covers more without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of Placer's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Aislinn, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

SDR output usually stalls on follow-up volume and ramp, not effort, and reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your team's target accounts.
email.body3:
Aislinn, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR reply rate likely compares to other high-growth analytics firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aislinn, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If helping your SDRs cover more without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling a team past $100M ARR is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I will tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
